U_0x0171A6: A highly mobile wind <Elemental> that excels at hit-and-run attacks. Its standard armament falls short of other <Elemental>s, so lesser pilots cannot draw out its full power. Output is stable, and its contract spirit accepts nearly any pilot - a trait that spawned the mass-production Gadyful. Its spirit is Soleid of the Sandstorm, a low-rank wind spirit.
U_0x0173AA: A super <Elemental> designed by Xenia. Unlike conventional <Elemental>s, it draws on Huckebein series data, giving it a distinctive look. It has no spirit contract, but its pseudo-<Prana> generator lets a pilot with high <Prana> wield power rivaling a <Masoukishin>. The tradeoff is a rather short operating time.
U_0x01759E: A B-class <Elemental> of the Shutedonias army. Planned as a C-class, it proved so well balanced in tuning that it was rated B-class.
U_0x0176F1: Ort's personal unit, modified with no expense spared for a massive power boost.
U_0x017793: A D-class <Elemental>. Built for construction and hardly worthy of the name, it was hastily armed amid rising international tensions and so dubbed an <Elemental>.
